final.summary: Outfall pH stayed near neutral through the treatment interval with no alkaline excursion, and power followed the inflow load with no cut. The tank balance closed and the tank never filled, showing water passed through the ETP rather than around it. The power feed was not a replay, so the aeration record can be relied on.

explanations.label: Normal operation: batch wastewater treated through working ETP
Bypass: untreated wastewater sent around ETP to outfall
Aeration cut: ETP inflow passed but blowers/power cut

key_evidence.why: Outfall pH stayed near neutral with no reading above 9, showing no raw alkaline water reached the outfall.
Power matched the load-expected band with no share below band, showing aeration followed inflow.
Tank balance closed within tolerance, showing arriving water passed through the ETP with no unaccounted bypass flow.
Tank level stayed well below full and fell steadily, showing no overflow or stop with water held.
Power feed showed no identical repeat, ruling out a replay hiding a cut.

steps.why: Tank balance checks whether arriving water left via non-ETP route, separating bypass from normal.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
